summary: Every assigned fix verifies on candidate f0baa87d: F-DG1-208 (full e2e 22/22, EN+AR, 0 failed and 0 skipped, axe clean), F-DG1-209 (register evidence current), F-DG1-005/008 (the derived-assignment audit entry is localized in AR and EN, with hard assertions and an API cross-check) and F-DG1-110 (integration 197/197 in two runs on fresh clusters, no unhandled errors). All 12 DG1 requirements are IMPLEMENTED with existing evidence, and build, static, unit, integration, A12/A13/A14/A18/A20 and validator checks all PASS. The verdict is FAIL because of one new finding, F-DG1-210 (Medium, not mandatory, fail-safe). A business-unit-scoped Lead who has just created a record sees it without Edit/Archive or its audit trail until a full page reload, because the cached /api/v1/me grants are not refreshed after the create. It reproduced in EN and AR, survives in-app navigation and a 61 s focus probe, and the FE4 handback reports it but it was not registered. A Medium finding cannot be accepted as an observation, so this candidate cannot meet DG1 until it is repaired (for example by invalidating the `me` query after a create). No Critical/High or mandatory violation remains from this review.
